skills.description: Agent-driven batch image processor for WorkBuddy. Use when the user uploads images (max 10, each ≤5MB) and describes in natural language what to do: compress, convert format, resize, OR enhance/deblur/upscale to higher definition using AI. The agent guides the user on usage, parses the request into a per-image spec, processes compress/format/resize with the bundled Pillow script and zips results, and for "enhance / 高清 / deblur" requirements calls WorkBuddy's image-generation (image-to-image) capability to genuinely improve resolution and clarity. Results are zipped and presented for local download. Trigger on "compress these 10 photos to 70%", "convert all to WebP", "make this blurry photo clearer / upscale it", "resize image 3 to 800px wide and shrink image 1 to 500KB".
